company.name: OpenSea
company.shortDescription: OpenSea is an NFT marketplace that enables users to discover, collect, and sell blockchain-based digital assets.
company.description: OpenSea is a peer-to-peer marketplace for crypto collectibles and non-fungible tokens. It includes collectibles, gaming items, and other virtual goods backed by a blockchain. On OpenSea, anyone can buy or sell these items through a smart contract.

productsAndServices.description: A peer-to-peer web3 marketplace for discovering, collecting, listing, buying, selling, and transferring NFTs and other blockchain-based digital assets across multiple networks.
productsAndServices.name: OpenSea Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: A discovery and analytics interface for exploring NFT collections, fungible tokens, market activity, categories, floor prices, sales, and trends across supported blockchains.
productsAndServices.name: OpenSea Discover

productsAndServices.description: A wallet-connected token swapping service that lets users exchange supported blockchain tokens through the OpenSea platform.
productsAndServices.name: OpenSea Swap

productsAndServices.description: A primary-release platform that helps creators and brands launch NFT collections, distribute digital assets, and provide users with access to new mints.
productsAndServices.name: OpenSea Drops

productsAndServices.description: A creator-oriented toolkit for developing and publishing NFT collections and primary drops on supported blockchain networks.
productsAndServices.name: OpenSea Studio

productsAndServices.description: API access, developer tools, and documentation for integrating OpenSea NFT and blockchain-asset data into applications and services.
productsAndServices.name: OpenSea API and Developer Tools
